content.what_it_is: PARALLEL_FIELD_IO는 PARALLEL 빌드에서 분산 필드를 ASCII 또는 MPI-IO binary로 내보내는 모듈이다(L52-L225). PutFileASCII는 각 rank의 ghost-cell 제외 내부를 LocalPHI로 복사하고(L98-L99), 분할 시작/끝 인덱스를 root에 gather한 뒤(L101-L110) rank별 point-to-point 전송으로 PHIGLOB을 조립한다(L112-L138). root는 OUTPUT_RES 간격으로 formatted field를 쓴다(L142-L155). PutFileBinary는 local/global MPI subarray datatype을 만들고(L179-L205), global start index로 file view를 설정한 다음 collective write를 한다(L208-L218).

unresolved: PutFileBinary opens with MPI_MODE_WRONLY + MPI_MODE_CREATE (L208-L210) and writes the current global view (L213-L218) but never calls MPI_FILE_SET_SIZE or otherwise truncates an already-existing file; if a later output is smaller, stale trailing bytes can remain.

PutFileASCII uses OUTPUT_RES as both outer and implied-DO stride (L144-L145) without any local positivity/range check; OUTPUT_RES=0 is an invalid DO step and a negative value suppresses the expected traversal.
